lines.trans: I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, madam, but never a piano.
A piano is just honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire, Chen.
Press the key to the left first so we see how a healthy hammer moves.
Watch C rise smoothly and strike the three strings—clean and bright.
Now press the silent key right next to it.
Look: the key goes down, but the little wooden hammer leans sideways!
Shine the lamp closer—the tiny brass hinge pin slipped half out of the wood!
Wait... nothing is cracked! The damp air thirty years ago only loosened the felt bushing!
Can you seat a tiny pin that small without splitting the beechwood, Chen?
Give me quiet light, thin tweezers, and dry glue tomorrow morning.
Once that hammer stands straight, Teacher Song can tune the whole middle octave?
Do you have a tuning key in the chest, Chen? Look in the bottom drawer!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí bàn. Combines 一 ('one') + 半 ('half'); note yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone bàn.

examples.text: 这壶热茶我们已经喝了一半。
examples.trans: We have already drunk half of this pot of hot tea.

examples.text: 第二页乐谱有一半还没有写完。
examples.trans: Half of the second page of sheet music is still unfinished.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì biān. Combines 一 ('one') + 边 ('side'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone biān.

examples.text: 请把湿雨伞放在门口的一边。
examples.trans: Please put the wet umbrella to one side of the doorway.

examples.text: 墙上的旧照片稍微歪向了一边。
examples.trans: The old photo on the wall leaned slightly to one side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià qù. Compound directional complement 下 ('down') + 去 ('away from speaker'), often attached after action verbs like 按下去 ('press down').

examples.text: 把开关轻轻按下去，走廊的灯就亮了。
examples.trans: Press the switch gently down and the hallway light comes on.

examples.text: 如果雨一直下下去，我们就在屋里喝茶。
examples.trans: If the rain keeps coming down, we will drink tea indoors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú guò. Gentle conversational 'though / however', softer than 但是.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng lái. Almost always paired with 没 or 不 to mean 'never before / never at all'.

examples.text: 我以前从来没见过这么古老的钢琴。
examples.trans: I have never seen such an old piano before.

examples.text: 老陈修东西从来不马虎。
examples.trans: Chen is never careless when repairing things.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū. Used for fixing pipes, locks, furniture, or appliances (修好 'fix completely').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng xiàn. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道光线 ('a beam of light').

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

examples.text: 向阳的阁楼早上光线特别好。
examples.trans: The south-facing attic has wonderful morning light.

related.gloss: a beam of light (measure word 道)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā dù. Musical interval of eight scale degrees: 八 ('eight') + 度 ('degree/interval').

examples.text: 请把这段旋律升高一个八度再弹一次。
examples.trans: Please raise this melody by one octave and play it again.

examples.text: 钢琴中央八度的音色最温暖。
examples.trans: The tone of the piano's middle octave is the warmest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Used for physical movement (别动 'don't move!').

examples.text: 全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
examples.trans: Hold everything! What time is it right now? Nine thirty-five!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: què. Always sits AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb to mark contrast ('yet, surprisingly').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ shì. Softens an explanation ('I simply…').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ yào. Pairs with 就 in the next clause: 只要…就… ('as long as…, then…').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě shì. Conversational 'but' introducing a contrast.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Preposition or verb complement indicating direction of movement or orientation (歪向一边 'lean toward one side').

examples.text: 向日葵总是朝着太阳的方向生长。
examples.trans: Sunflowers always grow toward the sun.

examples.text: 小晴笑着向窗外的朋友们挥了挥手。
examples.trans: Qing smiled and waved toward her friends outside the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dō yīn. Combines solfège 哆 (dō, 'Do / C') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 先按下中央哆音，听听琴弦的声音准不准。
examples.trans: Press middle C first and listen to whether the strings are in tune.

examples.text: 这首练习曲从明亮的哆音开始。
examples.trans: This etude begins on a bright C note.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí zài. Describes sturdy materials, unpretentious food, or dependable people.

examples.text: 钢琴里面全是实在的木头、毛毡和钢丝。
examples.trans: Inside a piano it is all solid wood, felt, and steel wire.

examples.text: 这碗热扁豆汤用料实在，喝一碗就饱了。
examples.trans: This bowl of hot lentil soup is made with hearty ingredients; one bowl fills you right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān máo jǔ mù. Fine-grained hardwood (山毛榉 'beech tree' + 木 'wood') traditionally used in piano actions and hammer shanks.

examples.text: 钢琴里面的许多小零件都是用坚硬的山毛榉木做的。
examples.trans: Many small parts inside a piano are made of hard beechwood.

examples.text: 修山毛榉木的时候动作一定要轻，免得弄裂。
examples.trans: When repairing beechwood you must work gently so as not to split it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng liè. Resultative compound 弄 ('cause to become') + 裂 ('cracked/split').

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子装轴销，一点也没弄裂山毛榉木。
examples.trans: Chen seated the pin with fine tweezers without splitting the beechwood at all.

examples.text: 钉钉子以前先钻个小孔，才不会把木板弄裂。
examples.trans: Drill a tiny pilot hole before hammering a nail so you won't split the board.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái. Means raising upward or two people lifting an object together.

examples.text: 我们俩一起把这扇长窗板抬进走廊吧。
examples.trans: Let's lift this tall shutter together and carry it into the hallway.

examples.text: 按下琴键时，里面的小琴槌就会稳稳抬起来。
examples.trans: When you press the piano key, the small hammer inside rises smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu ti. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个抽屉 ('a drawer').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 备用钥匙放在前台右边的抽屉里。
examples.trans: The spare keys are kept in the right-hand drawer at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà zhōng. Combines 挂 ('hang on a wall') + 钟 ('clock').

examples.text: 前台后面的老挂钟每到整点就会轻轻敲响。
examples.trans: The old wall clock behind the front desk chimes softly every hour on the hour.

examples.text: 老陈修好了大堂里那座停了很久的挂钟。
examples.trans: Chen repaired the wall clock in the lobby that had been stopped for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo zhòng. Resultative compound 敲 ('strike/knock') + 中 (zhòng, 4th tone 'hit the target').

examples.text: 包着毛毡的琴槌稳稳敲中了三根钢丝琴弦。
examples.trans: The felt-wrapped piano hammer struck the three steel strings squarely.

examples.text: 鼓槌清脆地敲中鼓心，发出了洪亮的声音。
examples.trans: The drumstick struck the center of the drum crisply with a resonant sound.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng liàng. Describes both well-lit spaces and clear, ringing musical tones.

examples.text: 擦掉灰尘以后，九号房变得格外宽敞明亮。
examples.trans: After wiping away the dust, Room Nine became remarkably spacious and bright.

examples.text: 这个琴键弹出来的声音干净又明亮。
examples.trans: The sound played by this piano key is clean and bright.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天一天 ('all day tomorrow').

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 工 ('craft/artisan'); modifies tools and materials like 木工胶水 ('woodworking glue').

examples.text: 老陈的工具箱里常备着细砂纸和木工胶水。
examples.trans: Chen's toolbox always keeps fine sandpaper and woodworking glue on hand.

examples.text: 这把结实的圆木椅是一位老木工亲手做的。
examples.trans: This sturdy wooden chair was handmade by a veteran carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù xiāng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 箱 ('chest/box').

examples.text: 最下面的抽屉里没有的话，再找找那个旧木箱吧。
examples.trans: If it isn't in the bottom drawer, check inside that old wooden chest.

examples.text: 老陈把修钢琴的小工具整齐地收进木箱。
examples.trans: Chen packed the small piano-repair tools neatly into the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng cháng. Describes normal water pressure or normal operation.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 修好阀门以后，三楼水压完全正常了。
examples.trans: After fixing the valve, third-floor water pressure is completely normal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wāi. Describes something tilting off straight alignment (歪向一边 'lean to one side').

examples.text: 琴键按下去的时候，里面的小琴槌歪向了一边。
examples.trans: When the piano key went down, the little hammer inside leaned sideways.

examples.text: 墙上的木框画有点歪，我们把它扶正吧。
examples.trans: The wood-framed picture on the wall is tilting a bit; let's straighten it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo zhān. Combines 毛 ('wool/hair') + 毡 ('pressed felt'), used inside piano actions for dampers, bushings, and hammers.

examples.text: 三十年前潮湿的空气只是让小小的毛毡轴套变松了。
examples.trans: The damp air thirty years ago merely loosened the tiny felt bushing.

examples.text: 椅子脚底下贴了毛毡垫，挪动时一点声音也没有。
examples.trans: Felt pads are stuck under the chair legs so they make no sound when moved.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá chū lái. Directional compound 滑 ('slide/slip') + 出来 ('come out').

examples.text: 那根细小的黄铜轴销从木头孔里滑出来一半。
examples.trans: That tiny brass hinge pin slipped halfway out of the hole in the wood.

examples.text: 夹在旧书里的一张明信片轻轻滑出来落在桌上。
examples.trans: A postcard tucked inside the old book slipped gently out onto the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo shī. Combines 潮 ('moist/damp') + 湿 ('wet').

examples.text: 三十年前那个雨夜潮湿的空气让毛毡轴套变松了。
examples.trans: The damp air on that rainy night thirty years ago loosened the felt bushing.

examples.text: 梅雨季节空气潮湿，木头窗户要常常通风。
examples.trans: During the rainy season the air is humid, so wooden windows need regular airing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯 ('a lamp').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

meanings.en: shine; follow/according to; take a photo
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào. Means sunlight shining in, or acting according to a plan (照着).

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 早上的阳光照进安静的书房。
examples.trans: Morning sunlight shines into the quiet study.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín xián. Combines 琴 ('stringed/keyboard instrument') + 弦 ('taut string').

examples.text: 哆音的琴槌稳稳抬起来，敲中了三根明亮的琴弦。
examples.trans: The C hammer rose smoothly and struck the three bright piano strings.

examples.text: 调音的时候要轻轻转动扳手，免得拉断旧琴弦。
examples.trans: Turn the wrench gently while tuning so you don't snap an old piano string.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín chuí. Combines 琴 ('piano') + 槌 ('wooden mallet/hammer'): the felt-covered wooden hammer inside a piano action.

examples.text: 一旦那根歪掉的琴槌站直了，钢琴就能重新调音了。
examples.trans: Once that tilted piano hammer stands straight, the piano can be tuned again.

examples.text: 打开立式钢琴的前面板，就能看见整排包着毛毡的琴槌。
examples.trans: Lift off the upright piano's front panel and you can see the whole row of felt-wrapped hammers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín jiàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个琴键 ('a piano key').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng qì. Measure word (量词): 口 (kǒu), e.g. 一口新鲜空气 ('a breath of fresh air').

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 打开窗户，让雨后新鲜的空气进来吧。
examples.trans: Open the window and let the fresh post-rain air in.

related.gloss: a breath of fresh air (measure word 口)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn zhí. Resultative compound 站 ('stand') + 直 ('straight/upright').

examples.text: 只要那根歪掉的琴槌重新站直了，琴键就能响了。
examples.trans: Once that leaning piano hammer stands straight again, the key will sound.

examples.text: 拍照的时候请大家站直，看镜头微笑！
examples.trans: Please stand up straight and smile at the camera for the photo!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

紧挨.gloss: be right next to; sit flush beside

meanings.en: be right next to; sit flush beside
meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn āi. Combines 紧 ('tightly/closely') + 挨 ('be next to'), usually followed by 着.

examples.text: 现在请按一下紧挨着哆音的那个琴键。
examples.trans: Now please press the piano key right next to C.

examples.text: 咖啡角紧挨着洒满阳光的小院子。
examples.trans: The café corner sits right next to the sunlit courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xì. Describes slender tools (细镊子 'thin tweezers'), fine grit (细砂纸), or careful work.

examples.text: 明天早上给我一把细镊子和一点木工胶水就行。
examples.trans: Just give me thin tweezers and a little woodworking glue tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 春天的细雨轻轻落在院子的常春藤叶上。
examples.trans: Fine spring rain fell softly onto the ivy leaves in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xì xiǎo. Combines 细 ('slender/fine') + 小 ('small').

examples.text: 那根细小的黄铜轴销从木头里滑出来了一半。
examples.trans: That tiny brass hinge pin slipped halfway out of the wood.

examples.text: 老陈戴上眼镜，仔细检查每一个细小的零件。
examples.trans: Chen put on his glasses and carefully inspected every tiny part.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng máo zhān. Combines 羊毛 ('sheep's wool') + 毡 ('pressed felt'), prized inside acoustic pianos for warm tone.

examples.text: 立式钢琴的琴槌头上包着厚实柔软的羊毛毡。
examples.trans: The heads of an upright piano's hammers are wrapped in thick, soft wool felt.

examples.text: 钢琴不过是实在的木头、羊毛毡和钢丝。
examples.trans: A piano is simply honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo shuǐ. Combines 胶 ('glue/resin') + 水 ('liquid').

examples.text: 老陈用一滴木工胶水把松动的毛毡轴套粘牢了。
examples.trans: Chen used a tiny drop of woodworking glue to secure the loose felt bushing.

examples.text: 等胶水完全干透以后，再试着按一下琴键。
examples.trans: Wait until the glue dries completely before testing the piano key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liè kāi. Resultative compound 裂 ('crack/split') + 开 ('apart/open').

examples.text: 太好了，钢琴里面的老木头一点都没裂开！
examples.trans: Wonderful—none of the old wood inside the piano is cracked!

examples.text: 冬天空气太干燥时，旧木板有时会裂开一道细缝。
examples.trans: When winter air gets too dry, old wooden boards sometimes crack slightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng huí. Resultative compound 装 ('install/fit') + 回 ('back into place').

examples.text: 老陈能把这么细小的黄铜轴销稳稳装回木头孔里。
examples.trans: Chen can seat a tiny brass hinge pin that small cleanly back into the wood.

examples.text: 等绿油漆干透以后，我们再把四扇窗板装回合页上。
examples.trans: Once the green paint dries completely, we will hang all four shutters back on their hinges.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn. Separable verb-object compound 调 (tiáo, 2nd tone 'adjust/harmonize') + 音 ('pitch/tone').

examples.text: 等老陈修好那根琴槌，宋老师就能给钢琴调音了。
examples.trans: Once Chen fixes that piano hammer, Teacher Song will be able to tune the piano.

examples.text: 音乐会开始前，调音师花了一个小时给钢琴仔细调音。
examples.trans: Before the concert began, the technician spent an hour carefully tuning the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn bān shǒu. Combines 调音 ('tune') + 扳手 ('wrench/spanner'): the star-tip L-lever used on piano tuning pins.

examples.text: 老陈在木箱最下面的抽屉里找到了一把旧调音扳手。
examples.trans: Chen found an old tuning wrench in the bottom drawer of the wooden chest.

examples.text: 使用调音扳手的时候手腕要稳，每次只轻轻转一点点。
examples.trans: Keep your wrist steady with a tuning wrench, turning only a tiny fraction at a time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu tào. Combines 轴 ('pivot pin/axle') + 套 ('lining sleeve'): in a piano action, the tiny cloth/felt ring lining a pin hole.

examples.text: 潮湿空气让细小的毛毡轴套松了，所以轴销才会滑出来。
examples.trans: Damp air loosened the tiny felt bushing, which let the hinge pin slip out.

examples.text: 换上紧实的毛毡轴套以后，琴槌就不再左右摇晃了。
examples.trans: Once fitted with a snug felt bushing, the piano hammer no longer wobbles sideways.

轴销.gloss: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)

meanings.en: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu xiāo. Combines 轴 ('pivot') + 销 ('metal pin/peg'): the tiny brass center pin on which a piano hammer pivots.

examples.text: 把手电筒照近一点，就能看见那根黄铜轴销滑出来一半。
examples.trans: Shine the light closer and you can see that brass hinge pin slipped halfway out.

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子夹住黄铜轴销，稳稳地推回了原位。
examples.trans: Chen gripped the brass pin with fine tweezers and seated it steadily back in place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Stative adjective ('near') and resultative complement after verbs (照近一点 'shine closer').

examples.text: 请把台灯照近一点，好让我看清楚里面的小零件。
examples.trans: Please shine the lamp a little closer so I can see the tiny parts inside clearly.

examples.text: 小院客栈离星期六的蔬菜集市非常近。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn is very close to the Saturday vegetable market.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng sī. Combines 钢 ('steel') + 丝 ('fine wire/filament'), the high-tension wire used for treble and middle piano strings.

examples.text: 钢琴里面全是实在的木头、羊毛毡和紧绷的钢丝。
examples.trans: Inside a piano it is all honest wood, wool felt, and taut steel wire.

examples.text: 老陈用钳子把那根松掉的细钢丝重新固定好。
examples.trans: Chen used pliers to fasten the loose steel wire securely back in place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guō lú. Combines 锅 ('cauldron/pressure vessel') + 炉 ('furnace/stove').

examples.text: 老陈修过客栈的热水锅炉、门锁和挂钟，手艺样样精通。
examples.trans: Chen has fixed the inn's hot-water boiler, door locks, and wall clocks—skilled at every trade.

examples.text: 入冬以前，我们要请师傅把暖气锅炉检查一遍。
examples.trans: Before winter sets in, we will have a technician inspect the heating boiler.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niè zi. Combines 镊 ('pinch with fine tongs') + noun suffix 子.

examples.text: 整首圆舞曲的中央瑞音，现在全靠老陈手里那把细镊子啦！
examples.trans: Middle D for the whole waltz now rests on that pair of fine tweezers in Chen's hand!

examples.text: 修手表和修钢琴一样，都离不开顺手的细尖镊子。
examples.trans: Repairing watches, just like repairing pianos, relies on fine-tipped tweezers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén suǒ. Clear disyllabic noun 门 ('door') + 锁 ('lock').

examples.text: 九号房那把老铜门锁滴了两滴机油后就很好开了。
examples.trans: After two drops of oil, Room Nine's old brass door lock turned smoothly.

examples.text: 晚上关店的时候，小晴总会把前后两道门锁检查一遍。
examples.trans: When closing up at night, Qing always double-checks both the front and back door locks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
